name: Wrecking Yard
tagline: One ball. A yard full of trouble.
description: A portrait Unity WebGL arcade game: drag to aim the wrecking ball, pull back for power, and release to swing. Real 3D rendering straight from the Unity player rather than a 2D stand-in, a 9:16 play area that scales to fit any screen, and mouse and touch controls. Nothing to install - the payload streams in behind a progress bar and the game runs entirely in the browser.
highlights: Native Unity WebGL build - real 3D rendering, not a 2D stand-in
Drag to aim and pull back for power, release to swing
Yards with a demolition target and a limited number of swings
Portrait 9:16 play area, scaled to fit phones, tablets and desktops
Mouse and touch input, no install and no download
howToPlay: Open the game and wait for the Unity progress bar - the first load streams about 56 MB
Drag to aim the ball and pull back for power, then release to swing
Reach the demolition target before your swings run out
Use the fullscreen button in the footer for the whole 9:16 view
